2608.20927.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation
2608.20927.paper_summary: Cross-model latent guidance lets a frozen large mentor encode an input once and a frozen small student generate from the resulting signal. Existing methods keep this signal fixed, assuming it stays useful as the output grows; we show this fails in long-form generation. On multi-turn instruction following, static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens changes only the memory content and restores a 2.0-point gain over that baseline. We propose MentorPulse to keep guidance fresh at practical cost: it compresses mentor states into a capped slot memory, incrementally processes newly generated tokens, and updates the memory that the student reads through gated cross-attention without resetting the student's KV cache. Windowed Refresh Training exposes the bridge to prefix-conditioned memory. Across thirteen datasets, MentorPulse closes 52.2% of the mentor-student gap on macro average, outperforming C2C, T2T, and equal-budget LoRA, with the largest gains on long outputs. It performs best on all eleven mentor-student pairs from three model families, with margins that narrow as the capability gap grows, and a lightweight read-pattern check predicts the gain before deployment. Measured costs identify refresh intervals that dominate text guidance on long outputs.
2608.20927.paper_summary_zh: 跨模型潛在引導讓一個凍結的大型導師對輸入進行一次編碼，而一個凍結的小型學生則從生成的信號中進行生成。現有的方法保持這個信號固定，假設它在輸出增長時仍然有用；我們展示這在長文本生成中是失敗的。在多輪指令跟隨中，靜態引導使得4B學生的約束滿足度比無引導基準低2.5分；每16個標記進行一次無需訓練的刷新僅改變記憶內容，並恢復了比該基準高2.0分的增益。我們提出了MentorPulse，以實際成本保持引導的新鮮感：它將導師狀態壓縮到一個上限槽記憶中，逐步處理新生成的標記，並通過門控交叉注意更新學生讀取的記憶，而不重置學生的KV緩存。窗口刷新訓練暴露了前綴條件記憶的橋樑。在十三個數據集上，MentorPulse在宏觀平均上縮小了52.2%的導師-學生差距，表現超過C2C、T2T和相等預算的LoRA，在長輸出上獲得了最大的增益。它在來自三個模型系列的所有十一對導師-學生配對中表現最佳，隨著能力差距的增長，邊際逐漸縮小，而輕量級的讀取模式檢查在部署前預測了增益。測量成本確定了在長輸出上主導文本引導的刷新間隔。
